Result· The prosthesis withstood physiologically relevant loading with only 82 μm permanent deformation after 10^5 cycles at the porous surgical neck.
Validation· Micro-computed tomography confirmed the as-built morphology matched the design, and mechanical testing validated fatigue performance.

Method· A hierarchical micro/nano topography was created on EBM Ti-6Al-4V implants by combining ultrasonic acid etching with anodic oxidation.

相关性: 该论文通过八面体点阵结构调节弹性模量以匹配人体骨骼，直接针对应力遮挡问题，但缺乏疲劳测试和表面形貌分析。
边界: Lacks fatigue testing, quantitative surface roughness, or osseointegration characterization.

结果· 边径0.4mm、边长1.5mm的点阵模量最接近人骨。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To mitigate stress shielding by tailoring the elastic modulus of porous implant structures to match that of human bone.
Method· Optimized octahedral lattice Ti6Al4V structures with varying edge diameters and cell lengths were designed, fabricated via selective laser melting (SLM), and evaluated through finite element simulation and uniaxial compression testing.
Result· The octahedral lattice with an edge diameter of 0.4 mm and unit cell length of 1.5 mm exhibited an elastic modulus closest to human bone.
Validation· Mechanical validation was performed via standard compression tests and microstructural analysis using scanning electron microscopy (SEM).

Motivation· To determine optimal selective laser melting parameters for AlSi10Mg aluminum alloy to maximize tensile strength and ductility.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the specific energy absorption of TPMS sheet-based structures under impact loading for lightweight applications.
Method· Two TPMS structures (FRD and Neovius) were designed, fabricated via selective laser melting of SS316L, and tested under dynamic (2000/s) and quasi-static (0.005/s) compression.

Validation· Experimental validation using Direct Impact Hopkinson Bar for dynamic testing and SEM for print quality assessment.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To design a porous metal block with reduced stiffness to mitigate stress shielding and enhance osseointegration in total knee arthroplasty.
Method· Topology optimization combined with porous architecture was applied to redesign the metal block, and biomechanical performance was evaluated via finite element analysis.
Result· The optimized block achieved 40% weight reduction, decreased maximum stress by 11.6% compared to solid block, and increased proximal tibial stress by 18.6%.
Validation· The study relied solely on finite element simulation without experimental or mechanical testing.

相关性: 该论文涉及髋关节植入物表面改性以促进骨整合，但未涉及应力遮挡或微动等生物力学分析。
边界: No stress shielding quantification, no micromotion simulation, no FEA or biomechanical modeling of hip implant.
动机· 改善钛合金植入物骨整合能力，减少植入失败。
方法· 采用粉末混合电火花加工技术，以SiC粉末浓度等参数优化表面形貌。
结果· SiC浓度20 g/l时表面粗糙度和再铸层深度降低，显微硬度从320 HV提升至727 HV，表面生成纳米孔隙。
验证· 通过显微硬度测试、元素映射和表面形貌分析验证表面改性效果。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To enhance osseointegration of Ti6Al4V ELI implants by modifying surface topography and chemistry to reduce micromotion and implant failure.
Method· Powder-mixed electric discharge machining with varying SiC concentrations was used to create a surface with controlled roughness, recast layer, and nano-porosity.
Result· A 20 g/l SiC concentration significantly reduced surface fracture density and roughness, increased microhardness from 320 HV to 727 HV, and generated nano-pores (50-200 nm) beneficial for protein absorption.
Validation· Surface characterization including microhardness testing, elemental mapping, and topology analysis confirmed the modified surface properties.

English summary & terms

English summary & terms
Motivation· To suppress stress shielding in metallic implants by fabricating plates with low axial stiffness and high torsional stiffness via crystallographic orientation control.
Method· Two types of 316L stainless steel plates with orthogonal anisotropy were fabricated by selective laser melting, aiming for <100>/<110> and <110>/<111> orientations along in-plane directions.

Validation· Experimental validation was performed through uniaxial tensile testing of printed specimens.

Method· A split-mouth study was conducted on six edentulous male patients receiving four short implants under digital guidance, with two different PBM doses (3.75 J/cm2 and 7.5 J/cm2) randomly assigned to each side.
